name: Cody shared OOBE palette v2
purpose: Shared palette for the Cody rig PoC and its host preview; original boot images retain their independent indexed palettes.
binary_format: 256 RGB565 uint16 words, little endian, in ascending slot order
gradient_interpolation: Piecewise linear interpolation in sRGB byte channels; nearest integer with midpoint away from zero.
rgb565_policy: Bit truncation, matching scripts/package_cody_boot.py; distinct preview slots may collapse to the same RGB565 value.

groups.name: reserved
groups.usage: Unallocated; must not be referenced by current artwork, typography, or controls.

existing_boot_packaging.policy: Independent per-asset palettes capped at 64 colors, with black at index 0.
existing_boot_packaging.source_png_policy: Source PNG files remain unchanged full-color image assets; they are not indexed with this shared palette.
existing_boot_packaging.integration_status: Design only: no palette replacement, shared-palette re-encoding, consumer changes, or firmware validation.
